The girl watches the cat with interest, maintaining a respectful distance. (10) The scene shows a wider view of a playroom where another young girl in a white t-shirt is seen near a toy kitchen. She holds a small colorful book or toy in her hands, observing the cat's movements closely with a gentle expression. (12) An ending card appears with a solid pink background.
